title: You can destroy someone in a debate… and still lose spiritually.
paragraphs: You can destroy someone in a debate… and still lose spiritually.
You can quote Scripture flawlessly and still grieve the Spirit.
Not every argument you win is a victory.
Some debates don’t defend truth. They defend pride.
Jesus didn’t come to build sharp tongues. He came to form surrendered hearts.
There’s a version of “being right” that feeds your ego while starving your spirit.
You can convince everyone else… and still be out of alignment.
“The anger of man does not produce the righteousness of God.” — James 1:20
Sometimes the holiest move isn’t the final word.
It’s walking away before your tone contradicts your theology.
Am I defending truth… or defending myself?
If you’ve ever realized you were right — but wrong in spirit — comment HEART.
